content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Cloudflare Workers are serverless functions that run on Cloudflare’s global edge network. They execute code closer to your users, reducing latency. For crypto payments, this means instant verification. NOWPayments acts as the payment processor, supporting 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts required. When a payment hits the blockchain, NOWPayments sends a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker. The Worker verifies the transaction, updates your order database (Supabase or Google Sheets), and triggers file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This isn’t a Stripe replacement — it’s a rearchitected payment stack. You own the code. You control the data. Your customers pay in USDT on Tron or Solana for fees under $0.10 per transaction. No platform can shut you down. No currency collapse can block you. This is infrastructure sovereignty.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Here’s the flow: A customer buys your product. Payment goes to your NOWPayments wallet in USDT. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and sends a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker. The Worker checks the payment status, updates your order database, and generates a secure download link. The customer gets the product instantly. No manual intervention. No waiting for payouts. Cloudflare Workers ensure this runs globally — fast. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 hosts your files. Everything’s decoupled. If one component fails, the rest keep working. This isn’t duct-taped together. It’s designed for resilience. Cloudflare’s edge network ensures low latency. Crypto ensures global accessibility. Webhooks ensure automation. You deploy this once, and it runs forever — no subscriptions, no recurring fees. Your stack becomes your asset, not someone else’s revenue stream.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, or software and can’t collect payment, this stack is for you. If your customers struggle with P2P conversions in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan, this stack solves that. If you’re tired of payout delays or currency devaluation, this stack gives you control. It’s not a workaround — it’s a rearchitected system. You don’t rent infrastructure. You own it. No platform can lock you out. No government can block your payments. This is built for creators who choose sovereignty over dependency. It’s pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are the norm. If it works there, it works anywhere.
Cloudflare Workers run your backend logic on a global edge network — no servers required.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. They’re serverless, fast, and global. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. No KYC. No buyer accounts. Webhooks connect NOWPayments to your Worker. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Each component is replaceable. Don’t like Supabase? Use Google Sheets. Don’t like USDT? Use BTC or SOL. The stack is modular. You own the code. You control the data. Cloudflare’s edge network ensures speed. Crypto ensures accessibility. Webhooks ensure automation. This isn’t a product — it’s a blueprint. Deploy it once, and it’s yours forever. No platform fees. No subscriptions. Just sovereign infrastructure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start with the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. It deploys in 48 hours with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, end-to-end testing, and 30-day support. If you prefer DIY, buy the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for complete docs and source code. Need more? The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates. Deploy on your domain. Load your products. Start selling globally. Your customers pay in USDT on Tron or Solana for low fees. You get paid instantly. No platform dependency. No payout delays. This is how you build a sovereign commerce stack — not as a workaround, but as a permanent solution. Your infrastructure. Your rules.

Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, NOWPayments processes crypto payments, and webhooks trigger instant actions. This stack bypasses Stripe and PayPal restrictions, enabling digital creators in regions like Pakistan, Nigeria, and Zimbabwe to sell globally without platform dependency. Payments settle on-chain in minutes, not weeks. Customers pay in USDT on low-fee networks like Tron or Solana. You own the infrastructure — no subscriptions, no recurring fees.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Edge Commerce Stack for done-for-you deployment or Sovereign Blueprint for DIY. 2. Register a domain (optional) or use GitHub Pages/Cloudflare Pages for free hosting. 3. Set up a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. 4. Deploy Cloudflare Workers to handle backend logic and webhook verification. 5. Connect Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. 6. Upload your products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. 7. Test end-to-end: Place a test order, verify payment, and ensure product delivery. 8. Launch your store and start selling globally.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys everything for you in 48 hours. No coding required. You get a fully operational store with crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
What cryptocurrencies are supported?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended for low fees: USDT on Tron or Solana, with transaction costs under $0.10.
Do I need to host my own server?
No. Cloudflare Workers and Pages provide serverless hosting. Your backend logic runs on Cloudflare’s global edge network, and your storefront is hosted for free.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your NOWPayments dashboard. Since you own the infrastructure, you control the refund process directly — no platform intermediaries.
What happens if Cloudflare or NOWPayments goes down?
Your stack is decoupled. If one component fails, the rest keep working. Cloudflare’s uptime is 99.99%, and NOWPayments has redundant nodes. You retain full data ownership.
Webhooks automate product delivery the moment payment confirms — no manual intervention.
